function.arguments: {"observation": "`patient_id` has 48 duplicate values (i.e., 48 patients appear more than once), and the `sample_seq` column indicates that these are re-tests (max sample_seq > 1 for 48 patients). The data dictionary states that the row with the highest `sample_seq` should be kept for each patient.", "implication": "The population for this analysis must be deduplicated by `patient_id`, keeping only the row with the highest `sample_seq` per patient. Otherwise, the fraction of patients with severe disease will be miscalculated, because re-tested patients would be counted twice — once for each row — which would bias the estimate."}
function.name: note_finding
